title: Songs of the Savanna
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: A twelve-year-old girl in a rural village learns the old songs from her grandmother, and through them inherits a history the schoolbooks erased.
style: Warm, lyrical third-person, child's-eye clarity sharpening with age. Oral-story cadence woven into prose.
characters: Nankya — 12, curious, listening; Grandmother Naava — keeper of songs, patient, iron-willed.
setting: A village at the edge of the savanna, late 1990s.
notes: Open at dawn with Naava singing while grinding millet. Let the songs carry history. Keep the child's wonder front and center.
